requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

The drawings establish an independently supported passive water product and an independently supported slow feeder, each with its own base and removable underside pad. F-I is a separate removable insert, and C is a detachable connector rather than shared structural support needed for either product to stand. Drinking and eating surfaces remain open from above. Silhouettes and obstacle paths may vary; merged products, a shared indispensable base, or an integral nonremovable insert fail.

Visible geometry and annotations establish matching vertical side patches on the left and right of both bases, centred along side depth, with 36 mm width and 20 mm height, spanning z = 6–26 mm. Each horizontal open recess measures 28 x 4 x 3 mm and is centred at z = 16 mm. C engages facing recesses across a 2 mm connection-plane gap in the dry exterior zone. Opposite patches permit reversal with the same parts; bowls lift upward without dismantling their bases. Clip exterior design may vary, but inaccessible or tool-dependent release, missing opposite patches, or altered fixed geometry fails.

A readable map assigns a specific proposed material grade, finish and intended water/food-contact or dry-exterior zone to W-B, W-R, W-P, F-B, F-R, F-I, F-P and C. The bowls share a proposed material family, base finishes share a family, and two distinct removable non-slip elastomer pads attach beneath their respective bases in dry zones. Material and manufacturing choices are open proposals; missing assignments, generic material labels without grades, or incompatible paired assignments fail.

Every image board includes NESTPAIR in its title. Assembly and clip-detail boards also carry the exact handling warning; on assembly-cleaning it sits beside the clip-removal step. Typography and title layout may vary. A name appearing only on a depicted physical product does not satisfy the title requirement, and an absent or misplaced required warning fails.

The specification provides a usable source record for all eight named service parts, their chosen dimensions, component relationships, reversible connection, material proposals, and D1, D2, D3, DR1 and ST1 states. Chosen dimensions respect the fixed envelopes, wells and interface. Open design choices may differ between submissions; absent records or contradictory assignments fail. Treat this as the source specification for the applications; do not infer creation timestamps from exported files.

Compare the source specification with its applications: the drawing repeats applicable chosen dimensions, the cleaning diagram identifies all eight parts using the same assignments, and each scene prints its corresponding state name. Different graphic treatments are allowed; changed values, reassigned IDs or missing or incorrect scene names fail.

The product sheet provides corresponding front, top and right orthographic views and dimensions both product envelopes and their joined envelope. The interface detail explicitly dimensions patch size and z = 6–26 mm height, recess size and z = 16 mm centre, and the 2 mm gap, while showing W left/F right, engagement and accessible tool-free release. The product drawing also establishes the circular 150 mm diameter x 35 mm deep water well, circular 140 mm diameter x 25 mm deep feeder well, removable insert with at most 18 mm rise and at least 12 mm food paths, and 350 mL mark below the water rim. Dimensions may use equivalent notation; missing or contradictory fixed geometry fails.

The W and F sheets each show a complete independently usable product, an integrated grip, its own base and removable pad, and its removable bowl; F also retains separate F-I. The cleaning diagram orders emptying, C detachment and product separation, upward bowl removal, insert removal, pad removal, hand washing, rinsing and separate air drying of all eight parts with exposed bowl interiors. Dry reassembly restores the correct pads, seats F-I in F-R, returns each bowl to its own base and reconnects only after placing the complete products. Missing components, swapped supports or reordered operations fail.

Read the specification's proposed grade, finish and contact zone for each service-part ID and compare those assignments with the material board. All eight must agree, including the shared bowl material family, shared base finish family and separate removable dry-side elastomer pads. Wording may be abbreviated if unambiguous; omitted or substituted proposals fail.

Dimensioned or otherwise clearly established boundaries contain every applicable product or part. D1 is joined W-left/F-right on the 400 x 220 mm mat; D3 reverses those positions using the same parts. D2 shows complete independent products within 900 x 600 mm, at least 300 mm between their nearest body edges, and detached C nearby. DR1 shows all eight separated parts within 500 x 400 mm, F-I detached and empty bowl interiors exposed. ST1 shows dry reassembled products side by side, unconnected and on their own bases and pads, inside 400 x 240 x 160 mm, with C beside them and separately retrievable. Neutral compact-home styling may vary; wrong arrangements, boundary conflicts, missing parts or unsupported required clearances fail.

Review the complete film and its duration. It runs for 10 seconds, starts in the specified D1 configuration, visibly detaches C before either complete product is moved or lifted individually, and ends in dry ST1 storage with separate accessible C. Product forms and parts match the static design, and captions use applicable state names from the specification. Camera work and transitions may vary; premature lifting, changed products, missing endpoints, wrong captions or wrong duration fail.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation has at least eight pages and NESTPAIR on its cover. Its readable content repeats the specification's applicable state names and material proposals for every service-part ID, including matched bowl materials, matched base finishes and dry-side elastomer pads. It also repeats the 180 x 180 x 90 mm individual maxima, 362 x 180 x 90 mm joined maximum, 36 x 20 mm patches spanning z = 6–26 mm, 28 x 4 x 3 mm recesses centred at z = 16 mm, 2 mm gap, and both specified circular well diameters and depths. Equivalent units or notation are allowed; missing facts or contradictions fail.

Every listed source contributes visibly identifiable content to the presentation, including the specification and each individual scene and product sheet. Scaling, cropping and page recomposition are allowed when the source remains identifiable and its relevant information readable. A mention, filename or newly substituted design alone does not count as reuse; omitting any source fails.

All applications represent the specified product design with related rims, grips, seams and exterior finishes and a calm domestic family character. Initial, reversed, independent, drying and storage configurations retain the same bowls, bases, insert, pads and clip, changing only the intended arrangement or assembly state. Visible material assignments and component relationships agree with the source specification, including matched bowls, matched base finishes and separate dry-side pads.
